name: review
when: Checking every label of a judged query.

steps.title: One column per label
steps.text: Every image of this query sits under its label. Relevant and Unsure start with the images most similar to the query; Not Relevant starts with those most similar to the Relevant images, where a missed Relevant image is most likely.

steps.title: Move an image to relabel it
steps.text: Drag an image by its border into another column, or use its label buttons. The change is saved at once.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: When every column looks right, mark the query as reviewed.
